description: PostgreSQL 18 planar point input, constructor, output, storage, and error parity
sql: SELECT '(1.5,-2)'::point AS parenthesized, '1,2'::point AS bare, '(1000,-1000)'::point AS unbounded;
SELECT '(NaN,Infinity)'::point AS special, '(-Infinity,-0)'::point AS negative_special, '(0x1p2,2)'::point AS hexadecimal;
SELECT point(1, 2) AS constructed, pg_typeof(point(1, 2)) AS constructed_type;
CREATE TABLE type_matrix_point (id int4 PRIMARY KEY, location point NOT NULL);
SELECT id, location FROM type_matrix_point ORDER BY id;
